close_reason: ClientConfig.max_ws_message exposed (default 1 MiB) + validation. New connect_ws_with_limit free function takes explicit cap; existing connect_ws is now a thin wrapper using DEFAULT_WS_MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES. JmapClient::connect_ws_session convenience method uses self.config.max_ws_message. 3 new tests; rustdoc/clippy/fmt clean.
description: src/ws/mod.rs:41 — `MAX_WS_MESSAGE_BYTES: usize = 1 << 20` is a private const. ClientConfig exposes `max_sse_frame` for the analogous SSE limit (also defaulting to 1 MiB) but the WebSocket equivalent is not configurable. A user who needs larger SSE frames AND larger WS messages can bump SSE but will be blocked at 1 MiB on WS. Inconsistent surface. Either expose `max_ws_message: usize` on ClientConfig, or document why WS is fixed at 1 MiB. Note: locked crate.
title: WebSocket message size cap is hardcoded; ClientConfig has no ws_max_message setting
